operations.description: Classifies nine types of ID documents and detects alarms, with results returned in JSON format. Supported document types include Peru ID card, Cambodian ID card, Hong Kong ID card, Macao ID card, Myanmar ID card, Myanmar driver's license, Thai ID card, passport, and Chinese ID card.
Cambodian ID Card detects and extracts text from images of Cambodia-issued ID cards and converts the text into a structured format.
Chile ID Card recognizes the text in a Chile ID card image and returns the recognition result in JSON format.
This API detects and extracts text from images of Colombia-issued identity cards and converts the text into a structured format.

Detects and extracts the text in general table images that you upload (or the URLs redirecting to the image files stored on OBS), and converts the text into structured format. For details about the constraints on using this API, see [Constraints](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/productdesc-ocr/ocr_01_0006.html). For details about how to use this API, see [Introduction to OCR](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/qs-ocr/ocr_05_0001.html).

Detects and extracts text from images and returns the recognized text and coordinates. It can be used in various scenarios, such as scanned files, electronic documents, books, receipts, and forms. For details about the constraints on using this API, see [Constraints](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/productdesc-ocr/ocr_01_0006.html). For details about how to use this API, see [Introduction to OCR](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/qs-ocr/ocr_05_0001.html).

This API identifies and extracts text from images of identity documents issued by multiple countries and regions, such as ID cards, driving licenses, and passports, and converts the text into a structured format. ID: identification card,which is an identity card issued by a country or region, such as an ID card, voter registration card, and social security card.
Myanmar Driving License recognizes characters on a Myanmar-issued driver's license and returns the structured result in JSON format.
Myanmar ID Card recognizes information on Myanmar-issued national registration cards.
Passport recognizes the text on the first page of a passport and returns the structured information in JSON format.
This API detects and extracts text from Peru-issued identity cards and converts the text into a structured format.
This API detects and extracts key-value pairs, text, and table content from various document layouts, such as certificates, receipts, and forms, and converts the text into a structured format.
Thailand ID Card recognizes characters on a Thailand-issued national registration card and returns the structured result in JSON format.
Thailand License Plate recognizes the license plate information in a thailand license plate image and returns the license plate number and location.
Detects and extracts text from Vietnam-issued citizen identity cards and converts the text into a structured format.
Web Image recognizes characters in a web image and returns the structured result in JSON format.
